text:
anna: Quick note 9:00 PT deploy tomorrow: SDK v6.1.0 + docs enforcement for snippet metadata. We're requiring fenced code blocks to include a language tag (e.g., ```python) and an optional `interactive: true` YAML comment for runnable playground examples.

chris: Concrete rules?

anna: 1) All fenced blocks must have a language label. 2) If a snippet is runnable in the interactive playground, authors must add a first-line comment `# interactive: true` (or `// interactive: true` for JS/Go). The docs linter will flag missing labels and missing interactive markers for playground pages.

meera: Will this break existing snippets used in blog posts or external forks?

anna: We will be conservative: linter will WARN for 21 days then ERROR. We added an auto-fix tool `rwi-cli annotate-snippets --check|--fix` to insert language labels heuristically and add a comment placeholder for likely interactive blocks. There's also a mapping table in the PR describing how we infer languages.

docs-bot: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/713 "docs: enforce snippet language labels and interactive flag". Linter rules: SNIPPET_LANG_REQUIRED (docs-701), SNIPPET_INTERACTIVE_TAG (docs-702).

chris: Any Console UI changes? Authors want a quick preview to see which snippets will be flagged.

anna: Adding a "Snippet health" panel on the docs editor showing unlabeled blocks and suggested fixes. We'll also add a banner for 21 days for docs authors.

release-bot: Draft release note: "SDK v6.1.0 + docs: snippet metadata enforcement, rwi-cli helpers, 21d WARN -> ERROR schedule." Link to checklist: https://internal.redwood/releases/checklists/snippet-metadata

meera: I'll run the `--check` across the cookbook tonight and open follow-ups for tricky cases.

anna: Thanks 9. Please review the PR if you have edge cases.
